Cherry Jewells / ELLE EPOCE is an emerging Swiss jewellery label based in Zurich and a long-standing rental partner of the GLOBUS department store. For our branch in the Wallisellen Glattzentrum, we are looking for an enthusiastic and dedicated jewellery seller with immediate effect. If you have a passion for sparkling jewellery and would like to work in a dynamic team, then you have come to the right place!
